rules.rule: On a synthetic AI-persona panel, concepts longer than about 22 words scored 0.4 points lower on 1-10 appeal (90% CI -0.65 to -0.1; 9 variants, 7 concepts); fragile finding.
rules.advice: Consider trimming copy to about 22 words or fewer, but treat this as a tentative signal from AI personas and confirm with real-audience testing before making it a rule.
